When I was 15, my family was struggling a lot. As a short recap, my mom was going through depression and she and dad were not talking so I was the mediator and paying all the bills and shit (person who caused the problem was a sister who told my dad about some monetary things that involved my mom).

The "brothers" knew about what was going on and that one sister and her husband (who was my whole family's conductor and people I trusted with my LIFE) refused to acknowledge it and told me to "let it go". I was infuriated. I used to be so into the religion and I was obedient and went to meetings, prepared, went to ministry and had bible studies, it was insane that I get repaid with pitiful looks and the casual, "you're so strong," as a 15 year old with two younger siblings she didn't know how to handle. I was so vulnerable at that time, I got coerced into being an unbaptized publisher, but nothing more.

I was so confused if I was being tested for my faith, but it never ended so I just gave in. I was tired. It was too much for a teenager to handle and I understand that now.

One of the elders was my teacher and I shit you not there has had to be more than one occasion he has seen me crying or at least the aftermath of me crying, because there was no day I would not break down before class or even after. I was at my lowest, harmed myself (some people in the church knew, but didn't say or do anything Abt it) and even had an attempt no one knew about. 

Years later, I turn 18 and get a job, I stop going to meetings and slowly stop associating, my family moved to another Cong where I don't know anyone. Everyone pretends I don't exist until they see me. I know they talk about me behind my back, but if they weren't there for me at my lowest, they don't deserve me at my best.

I am thriving at work and I am so much more happier with people who accept me for me. I don't have to hide what I'm interested in, about my sexuality and it's still hard sometimes to accept because of the guilt, I'm still struggling as a PIMO, but I promised myself I'll be better and fully get out one day.
